subject: german

moments.title: Austria-Hungary
moments.body: The Ausgleich creates the dual monarchy. Vienna becomes a multilingual cultural capital.
moments.takeaway: German is one of many languages of central European empire.

moments.title: Anschluss
moments.body: Germany annexes Austria. Most Austrians initially welcome the move.

moments.title: Austrian neutrality
moments.body: The State Treaty restores Austrian sovereignty with permanent neutrality.
moments.takeaway: Cold War settlements created new national identities.

now.title: German-speaking world today
now.body: Austria, Switzerland, Liechtenstein and parts of Belgium and Italy keep German official. Common spelling reform coordinates orthography.
now.open_questions: How does German evolve across so many states?

reflection: There is no single German country.
